say:15:1322044011:1.text: You're broken... like a toy that's been cast aside. You have the body of a man but the mind of a child. Can you even control yourself, or are you lost in your own chaos?

say:59:1322055059:1.text: Your eyes shift to the golem next to you—Stitchy—and you couldn't help but feel compelled to acknowledge Daimon's sole companion.

choice:43:0:1.text: Sounds like you all had a tough time.
choice:43:0:1.source_cn: 听起来你们当年过得很艰难
choice:43:0:1.male: Sounds like you all had a tough time.
choice:43:0:1.female: Sounds like you all had a tough time.

choice:34:0:1.text: Are you being a little overprotective?
choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 你对戴蒙会不会有点过度保护
choice:34:0:1.male: Are you being a little overprotective?
choice:34:0:1.female: Are you being a little overprotective?

say:62:1322055036:1.text: You don't realize how weak Daimon's body is. His essence is overwhelmed by his fragile constitution.
say:62:1322055036:1.source_cn: 你们不明白戴蒙的身体有多虚弱，他的精神也因为羸弱的体质...

choice:34:1:2.text: Is health that important to Graveborn?
choice:34:1:2.source_cn: 亡灵还需要保养身体吗？
choice:34:1:2.male: Is health that important to Graveborn?
choice:34:1:2.female: Is health that important to Graveborn?

say:63:1322055037:1.text: The outside world? A cruel place where we were only ever tormented... I-I don't want to remember any of it.
say:63:1322055037:1.source_cn: 外界……呵，外面的人给我们的只有欺辱……我，我不想回忆...

choice:34:2:3.text: Kids should see the outside world.
choice:34:2:3.source_cn: 小孩子应该和外界交流
choice:34:2:3.male: Kids should see the outside world.
choice:34:2:3.female: Kids should see the outside world.

say:64:1322055023:1.text: That mischievous Graveborn? If we meet again, I'll apologize to him. I was a tad impulsive when we met...
say:64:1322055023:1.source_cn: ……那个喜欢玩闹的亡灵？如果有缘再见，我会向他道歉。初...

choice:21:1:2.text: Next time, you should apologize to Igor.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 下次你得给伊戈尔道歉
choice:21:1:2.male: Next time, you should apologize to Igor.
choice:21:1:2.female: Next time, you should apologize to Igor.

choice:8:0:1.text: You have wronged me, my lady.
choice:8:0:1.male: You have wronged me, my lady.
choice:8:0:1.female: You have wronged me, my lady.

say:65:1322055009:0.text: An oath is just empty words.
say:65:1322055009:0.source_cn: 誓言……呵，誓言太空洞了，不值得相信。

say:66:1322055010:0.text: Is that so, Daimon? Have you turned a deaf ear to my words?
say:66:1322055010:0.source_cn: 戴蒙，是这样吗？你不听我的话了？

say:0:1322056001:0.text: This thing is a bit big, but it's still cute...
say:0:1322056001:0.source_cn: 这个玩偶虽然大了点，但还是很可爱嘛……

say:1:1322057001:1.text: Having said so much, I forgot to formally apologize to you.
say:1:1322057001:1.source_cn: 啊……说了这么多，都忘了向你们正式道歉了。

say:2:1322057002:1.text: The panic in Cedartown this time was caused by Daimon and my lack of discipline. He snuck out and convinced the town's children to play at night. I understand why their parents are worried.
say:2:1322057002:1.source_cn: 这次雪松镇的恐慌，说到底是因为戴蒙和我管教不严才引发的...

say:3:1322057003:1.text: Come on, Daimon, it's time to apologize to everyone in Whiteridge.
say:3:1322057003:1.source_cn: 来吧，戴蒙，向白山公国的各位道个歉。

say:6:1322057004:1.text: I'm sorry, everyone... I shouldn't have done what I did.
say:6:1322057004:1.source_cn: 对不起……大哥哥、大姐姐……我、我做错了。

say:7:1322057005:1.text: I shall also apologize for my impulsive behavior the other day. I hope you can understand the feelings of a mother.
say:7:1322057005:1.source_cn: 我也要向你们再次道歉，我上次的行为太冲动。希望你们能体...

say:8:1322057006:0.text: Daimon, because of the panic you caused, I've decided to take your golem away for a while.
say:8:1322057006:0.source_cn: 戴蒙，因为这次引起的恐慌，我决定没收你的玩偶傀儡一段时间。

say:9:1322057007:0.text: Without it, you can't lead the children out of town... Stay with us and rest. This is for your own good.
say:9:1322057007:0.source_cn: 没有了它，你就没法再带镇上的孩子出来……求求你，这段时...

say:10:1322057008:0.text: *Cough*... What? Mother! No! You can't take away Stitchy!
say:10:1322057008:0.source_cn: 什么……咳，没收奇奇？妈妈！不要带走奇奇好不好？

say:11:1322057009:0.text: I'll only confiscate the big golem so you can't gather the town's children again. But the small Stitchy in your arms is yours to hold, just as it's always been.
say:11:1322057009:0.source_cn: 我只会没收你的大玩偶傀儡，如果留着大奇奇给你，你就一定...

say:12:1322057010:0.text: And I won't take it away for too long. After some time, I'll return it to you.
say:12:1322057010:0.source_cn: 而且我不会没收太久，过一段时间，我就把它还给你。

say:13:1322057011:0.text: But Mother... The big Stitchy is my only friend!
say:13:1322057011:0.source_cn: 可是、可是……妈妈，求求你……奇奇是我唯一的朋友了！

say:14:1322057012:0.text: Father, please. Don't let Mother take the big Stitchy away...
say:14:1322057012:0.source_cn: 爸爸，求你不要让妈妈带走奇奇……

say:17:1322057014:0.text: I am not changing my mind.
say:17:1322057014:0.source_cn: 你知道我不会改主意的。

say:18:1322057015:0.text: This is to keep you safe, Daimon. Stay here until the situation is resolved. Do you hear me?
say:18:1322057015:0.source_cn: 这是为了你的安全，戴蒙。在事态彻底平息之前，哪里都不要...

narration:21:1322057018:0.text: Daimon nods, brushing away his tears without a word, and disappears into the casket that is their temporary refuge.
narration:21:1322057018:0.source_cn: 戴蒙一边点头，他默默擦着眼泪，钻回了作为临时居所的棺材里

say:25:1322057020:0.text: Children are often emotional. When he cries, my heart breaks.
say:25:1322057020:0.source_cn: 小孩子很容易情绪化。他落泪的时候，我的心也如刀绞。

say:26:1322057021:0.text: But I'm sorry, my child. Please forgive me. I have to protect you.
say:26:1322057021:0.source_cn: 但是……对不起，我的孩子，原谅妈妈吧。我必须保护你。

say:2:1322058001:1.text: My love, you really hurt him this time.
say:2:1322058001:1.source_cn: 吾爱，你这次真的伤到他了。

say:3:1322058002:1.text: I feel terrible for Daimon, but I can't let him run around anymore. He's too naive. What if something happens to him?
say:3:1322058002:1.source_cn: 戴蒙这样我也很难受，可是不能让他再这样随意出去乱跑了，...

say:4:1322058003:1.text: My love, can we find a way to comfort him...? We need to make this up to him somehow.
say:4:1322058003:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，我们可以想个办法安慰安慰他……想个办法，给他做...

say:5:1322058004:1.text: My dear guests, you've played with Daimon before. Perhaps you know what he likes.
say:5:1322058004:1.source_cn: 远道而来的客人们，你们和戴蒙一起玩过，也许知道他会喜欢什么？

choice_prompt:6:1322058004.text: My dear guests, you've played with Daimon before. Perhaps you know what he likes.
choice_prompt:6:1322058004.source_cn: 远道而来的客人们，你们和戴蒙一起玩过，也许知道他会喜欢什么？

say:7:1322058005:1.text: No, it's far too dangerous outside! I'd rather let him be sad for a few days than risk him getting hurt.
say:7:1322058005:1.source_cn: 不，不行！外面太危险了，与其放纵他在外面遇险，我宁愿狠...

say:8:1322058006:1.text: Maybe a gift to replace the big Stitchy will cheer him up. It could help him feel better.
say:8:1322058006:1.source_cn: 也许我们送他一件礼物，作为奇奇的替代品，能让他开心些。

say:10:1322058008:1.text: When I was a physician in the army, I always brought him toys from my travels. His favorite was a little wooden horse... I remember how much he loved it.
say:10:1322058008:1.source_cn: 之前随军从医，我每次归乡时总会给他带些外面的玩具，记得...

say:11:1322058009:1.text: Yes, a wooden horse. He played with it daily until he broke one of its legs. After that, he kept asking for a new one.
say:11:1322058009:1.source_cn: 玩具木马……对，是有个玩具木马，他每天都要玩。后来那个...

say:12:1322058010:1.text: But later, his condition worsened, and he couldn't play with the wooden horse anymore...
say:12:1322058010:1.source_cn: 可后来戴蒙病情加重了，再也玩不了木马……

say:13:1322058011:1.text: Perhaps we could use this opportunity to craft a wooden horse for Daimon.
say:13:1322058011:1.source_cn: 哦，吾爱。正好趁这机会做一个木马给戴蒙，怎么样？

say:14:1322058012:1.text: Let's make up for our past regrets together...
say:14:1322058012:1.source_cn: 我们一起，弥补一下曾经的遗憾……

say:15:1322058013:1.text: It's rare that you come up with an idea like this.

say:16:1322058014:1.text: I failed as a husband in life. Now, in death, let's begin anew and leave the past behind us.
say:16:1322058014:1.source_cn: 生前我不算是个称职的丈夫，既然现在已经成为亡灵，就让我...

say:17:1322058015:1.text: Hmm, I've never crafted a wooden horse before. Shall I use bones for it? Let me consider this a bit...
say:17:1322058015:1.source_cn: 啊，木马，从没接触过的构造，能用骨头当材料吗？让我想想……

choice_prompt:18:1322058015.text: Hmm, I've never crafted a wooden horse before. Shall I use bones for it? Let me consider this a bit...
choice_prompt:18:1322058015.source_cn: 啊，木马，从没接触过的构造，能用骨头当材料吗？让我想想……

say:19:1322058016:1.text: Oh, you know how to craft a wooden horse? What a welcoming guest...
say:19:1322058016:1.source_cn: 哦，你知道该怎么做？多么热情的客人……
say:19:1322058016:1.male: Oh, you know how to craft a wooden horse? What a welcoming guest...
say:19:1322058016:1.female: Oh, you know how to craft a wooden horse? What a welcoming guest...

say:20:1322058017:1.text: Come, my love. Let's see what else we can do for Daimon...
say:20:1322058017:1.source_cn: 来吧，我的爱人，咱们看看还能为戴蒙做点什么……

choice:18:0:1.text: Bones? How about I help you?
choice:18:0:1.male: Bones? How about I help you?
choice:18:0:1.female: Bones? How about I help you?

choice:6:0:1.text: Let him go out and play. He'll like that.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 允许他出去玩，保准有效
choice:6:0:1.male: Let him go out and play. He'll like that.
choice:6:0:1.female: Let him go out and play. He'll like that.

say:0:1322059001:0.text: What are the materials we need to make a wooden horse?
say:0:1322059001:0.source_cn: 主人，做木马该用什么材料啊？
say:0:1322059001:0.male: What are the materials we need to make a wooden horse?
say:0:1322059001:0.female: What are the materials we need to make a wooden horse?

say:1:1322059002:0.text: Let's find the strongest piece of wood first.
say:1:1322059002:0.male: Let's find the strongest piece of wood first.
say:1:1322059002:0.female: Let's find the strongest piece of wood first.

say:0:1322060001:0.text: This type of wood seems sturdy enough!

say:0:1322061001:0.text: The sap from these plants can be used as an adhesive!
say:0:1322061001:0.source_cn: 这些植物的汁液可以用来做黏合剂……应该够用了！

say:0:1322062001:0.text: Let's go back. Niru and Shemira should be waiting for us.
say:0:1322062001:0.source_cn: 我们回去吧，尼汝和雪米拉一定等急了。
say:0:1322062001:0.male: Let's go back. Niru and Shemira should be waiting for us.
say:0:1322062001:0.female: Let's go back. Niru and Shemira should be waiting for us.

say:1:1322065001:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valka, what do you think about this wooden horse?
say:1:1322065001:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valka, what do you think about this wooden horse?

choice_prompt:4:1322065002.female: Hmm... Is this the finished piece? What do you think, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:5:1322065003:0.text: I prefer tongues that speak the truth...
say:5:1322065003:0.source_cn: ……我确实更喜欢收集能吐露真实的舌头，不过……

say:6:1322065005:1.text: Oh, I knew it. I'm great at sewing bodies and studying souls, but carpentry? That's beyond me. Shemira's a master at sewing, but wooden horses? That's a whole different skill.
say:6:1322065005:1.source_cn: 唉，我就知道……我擅长缝合人体、研究灵魂，但对木工活一...

say:7:1322065006:1.text: It would be best to find someone who can make a wooden horse to guide us. I remember there were quite a few dwarven craftsmen in Cedartown...
say:7:1322065006:1.source_cn: 最好找个会做木马的人指导一下。我记得雪松镇有不少矮人工匠……

choice_prompt:8:1322065006.text: It would be best to find someone who can make a wooden horse to guide us. I remember there were quite a few dwarven craftsmen in Cedartown...
choice_prompt:8:1322065006.source_cn: 最好找个会做木马的人指导一下。我记得雪松镇有不少矮人工匠……

say:9:1322065007:1.text: You seek Hugin's aid, do you not? His skill is truly remarkable... Shall we seek him out now?
say:9:1322065007:1.source_cn: 你想让呼金来帮忙，对吧？他的手艺确实真没得说……我们现...

say:15:1322065011:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I shouldn't have given you a Merlindabest!
say:15:1322065011:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I shouldn't have given you a Merlindabest!

say:17:1322065012:1.text: This device is most intriguing... Hugin, we apologize for the intrusion, but we require your aid.
say:17:1322065012:1.source_cn: 这通讯器真是有意思……呼金，很抱歉打扰你，但我们需要你...

say:20:1322065013:1.text: By the forge, it's Valka! Alright, okay. For Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I'll do as I must. What's the next marvel you're roping me into crafting?

say:21:1322065014:1.text: Let me guess—another one of your ice sculptures, a cannon to blow a hole in the mountain, or a mechanical snowman to terrorize the children? Oh, that's a good one. Let me write it down.
say:21:1322065014:1.source_cn: 冰雕？大炮？还是雪球大战时用的机械雪人？

choice_prompt:22:1322065014.text: Let me guess—another one of your ice sculptures, a cannon to blow a hole in the mountain, or a mechanical snowman to terrorize the children? Oh, that's a good one. Let me write it down.
choice_prompt:22:1322065014.source_cn: 冰雕？大炮？还是雪球大战时用的机械雪人？

say:23:1322065015:0.text: Yeah, it's an idea I've been thinking about ever since I came to Whiteridge. A snow-throwing automaton!
say:23:1322065015:0.source_cn: 嘿，这是我来白山之后才想到的新创意！全自动雪球大战机器人！

say:26:1322065016:0.text: Oh, let's talk about this next time. We actually just wanted you to guide us in making a wooden horse...
say:26:1322065016:0.source_cn: 呃，这个……还是下次再说吧。这次只想请你指导我们做玩具...

say:29:1322065017:1.text: What? Can you say that again?

say:32:1322065018:1.text: Can you hear Chippy now? The signal is bad! What about now? Do you hear anything? We said we wanted your help making a wooden horse. A WOODEN HORSE!
say:32:1322065018:1.source_cn: 是信号不好吗？我们——想请你——指导做——

say:35:1322065019:0.text: I heard you! Yeah! A wooden horse!

say:36:1322065020:1.text: By the roaring fires of the deep, I can't believe you roused me from my slumber for this. It's the hour when sane dwarves are dreaming of tools, hammers, and ale.
say:36:1322065020:1.source_cn: 不敢想象，你们就为了这种小玩意半夜把我叫起来？！现在是半夜！

say:39:1322065021:1.text: Master craftsman, please teach us. We only want to make a wooden horse for Daimon as a gift...
say:39:1322065021:1.source_cn: 这位矮人先生，拜托你教教我们，我们只想给戴蒙做一只玩具...

say:42:1322065022:1.text: Another Graveborn? And who's this Daimon? Bah, never mind—I'm already awake.
say:42:1322065022:1.source_cn: 嚯，新的亡灵？戴蒙又是谁……算了，反正已经被吵醒了。

say:43:1322065023:1.text: Alright, tell me, what kind of wooden horse are you looking for? One that rocks automatically, or one that fires cannon balls? I can do both!
say:43:1322065023:1.source_cn: 说说看，你们想要哪种木马？会自动摇摆的，还是能发射弹药的？

say:46:1322065024:1.text: The most common type! The kind for children...
say:46:1322065024:1.source_cn: 呃，最普通的，能给小孩子玩的那种……

say:49:1322065025:1.text: What...? You're lucky you're not here, or Hardhead would teach you a lesson you'd never forget!
say:49:1322065025:1.source_cn: ——要不是离得远，铁头一定会狠狠教训你！！

choice_prompt:50:1322065025.text: What...? You're lucky you're not here, or Hardhead would teach you a lesson you'd never forget!
choice_prompt:50:1322065025.source_cn: ——要不是离得远，铁头一定会狠狠教训你！！

say:51:1322065026:1.text: Fine, fine. A common wooden horse it is. Listen close because I'm only saying this once...
say:51:1322065026:1.source_cn: ……行吧行吧，最普通的木马款式对吧。你们听好了……

narration:52:1322065027:2.text: Though Hugin is angry, he still carefully explains the process of making a wooden horse to everyone...
narration:52:1322065027:2.source_cn: 呼金虽然十分生气，但还是仔细地传授了制作木马的方法……

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 雪球大战用的机械雪人？

choice:22:1:2.text: How do you make a wooden horse?
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 呃，想让你教我们做玩具木马……
choice:22:1:2.male: How do you make a wooden horse?
choice:22:1:2.female: How do you make a wooden horse?

choice:4:0:1.text: Do you want me to tell the truth?
choice:4:0:1.male: Do you want me to tell the truth?
choice:4:0:1.female: Do you want me to tell the truth?

say:62:1322065004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you speak truly or in jest?
say:62:1322065004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you speak truly or in jest?
say:62:1322065004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you speak truly or in jest?

choice:4:2:3.text: It's too ugly. Daimon won't like it.
choice:4:2:3.source_cn: 太丑了，戴蒙不会喜欢的！
choice:4:2:3.male: It's too ugly. Daimon won't like it.
choice:4:2:3.female: It's too ugly. Daimon won't like it.

say:2:1322066001:1.text: Look at this wooden horse—it's absolutely perfect, isn't it?
say:2:1322066001:1.source_cn: 这次的玩具木马做得真不错……

say:3:1322066002:0.text: Daimon will adore it. Thank you, Master Hugin, for your help. Your skill as a craftsman is unmatched.
say:3:1322066002:0.source_cn: 戴蒙一定会很喜欢的！非常感谢你的帮助，呼金先生。你真是...

say:5:1322066003:1.text: Thanks for the compliment, but let's not kid ourselves. This wooden horse is a glorified stick figure. It barely meets my standards.
say:5:1322066003:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，这句话我爱听！但这个木马可不算“真不错”，只是勉...

say:6:1322066004:1.text: Don't you think it needs some color? In the name of Hardhead and Whistler, a creation without color is but a shadow of what it could be!
say:6:1322066004:1.source_cn: 你们不觉得它缺了点颜色吗？颜色！以铁头和尖哨的名义，没...

say:9:1322066005:0.text: Well, I prepared some eyeballs and organs...

say:12:1322066006:1.text: What?! By the flame, are you mad?
say:12:1322066006:1.source_cn: 什么？！你们要用那些血淋淋的东西对这个新诞生的孩子做什么！？

say:13:1322066007:1.source_cn: 准备点正常的涂料！正常的！

say:14:1322066008:1.text: And when I say proper paint, I mean the normal stuff—pigments from plants, shells, and minerals. None of that Graveborn nonsense, ya hear?
say:14:1322066008:1.source_cn: 我说正常，是指用植物、螺壳、矿石粉末加工成的普通颜料。...

say:15:1322066009:1.text: ... Alright, I'm done. Whistler's whistling in my ear, Hardhead's hammering in my skull, and I am dead on my feet. Time to call it a night...
say:15:1322066009:1.source_cn: ……好啦，就这样吧。我、尖哨和铁头都困了，得回去好好睡...

say:16:1322066010:0.text: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time we cross paths, you owe me a proper meal!
say:16:1322066010:0.male: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time we cross paths, you owe me a proper meal!
say:16:1322066010:0.female: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time we cross paths, you owe me a proper meal!

say:19:1322066011:1.text: ... A marvel of creation. The sounds have ceased.

say:21:1322066012:0.text: Because he turned it off on his end.

say:24:1322066013:1.text: We need "normal stuff"... My love, what do you think of this fabric as decoration? Will Daimon like this pattern?
say:24:1322066013:1.source_cn: 需要“正常的颜料”啊……亲爱的，你觉得这块纺布做装饰怎...

say:27:1322066014:1.text: Of course! Although your hands may be deathly cold, my love, your skills at sewing are still superb...
say:27:1322066014:1.source_cn: 当然会了！你的手虽然冰冷，但纺起纱来仍然这么精巧……

say:28:1322066015:0.text: Friends, wait a moment. Shemira and I will go find the pigments that the Master Hugin mentioned... We don't want to bother you with such trivial matters.
say:28:1322066015:0.source_cn: 朋友们，稍等，我和雪米拉去找些工匠所说的颜料……呵呵，...

narration:29:1322066016:0.text: With your assistance, the colorful wooden horse is being completed swiftly.
narration:29:1322066016:0.source_cn: 在你们的帮助下，上好色的木马很快完成了

say:30:1322066017:1.text: What an amazing experience—not dissecting or dismembering, but creating and assembling... It's a refreshing change.
say:30:1322066017:1.source_cn: 真是奇妙的体验，不是解剖拆卸，而是重新组合装配……

say:31:1322066018:1.text: My love, let's give this gift to our son. He's going to adore it...
say:31:1322066018:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，把这件小东西拿给我们的儿子吧。他一定会喜欢这件...

say:3:1322067002:0.text: Didn't you always want a wooden horse? Mother and Father made one for you.
say:3:1322067002:0.source_cn: 戴蒙……你不是一直很想要玩具木马吗？妈妈爸爸给你做了一个。

say:4:1322067003:0.text: It's not that well-made, but we hope you like it...
say:4:1322067003:0.source_cn: 不是很精美，但……但我们希望你能喜欢……

say:6:1322067005:1.text: Perhaps it's the depth of his sadness and anger that keeps Daimon silent. He doesn't say a single word.
say:6:1322067005:1.source_cn: 或许是因为太伤心，太生气，戴蒙一句话都没有说。

say:7:1322067006:1.text: Please don't be angry at Mother, Daimon.
say:7:1322067006:1.source_cn: 戴蒙……别生妈妈的气，好不好？戴蒙？

say:8:1322067007:1.text: Have we been too hard on him? Should we return the big Stitchy back to him?
say:8:1322067007:1.source_cn: 他应该很难受，要不……咱们把奇奇还给他？

say:9:1322067008:1.text: If the golem is with him, he'll surely sneak out again. We cannot give him back to Daimon.
say:9:1322067008:1.source_cn: 但是要是有了奇奇，戴蒙肯定又会忍不住跑出去……不行，奇...

say:10:1322067009:1.text: But, my love, isn't this a bit harsh...?
say:10:1322067009:1.source_cn: 唉……吾爱，也别对他太严苛。

say:11:1322067010:1.text: Let's think of something else. What else can we do to cheer him up?
say:11:1322067010:1.source_cn: 我们想想别的办法……要怎么才能让戴蒙开心一点？

choice_prompt:12:1322067010.text: Let's think of something else. What else can we do to cheer him up?
choice_prompt:12:1322067010.source_cn: 我们想想别的办法……要怎么才能让戴蒙开心一点？

say:16:1322067011:1.text: You took away the big Stitchy! He feels alone right now! What he needs is playmates!
say:16:1322067011:1.source_cn: 你们没收了奇奇，他一个人多孤单，只有玩伴才能让他开心起来！

say:17:1322067012:1.text: Well... if Daimon can't go out, then we can just create some playmates for him.
say:17:1322067012:1.source_cn: 唔……要是戴蒙不方便出门的话，那我们就在这里“制造玩伴...

say:18:1322067013:1.text: Do you remember the mage Witstaff from the Snowspire Festival? He created snowmen that could run around.
say:18:1322067013:1.source_cn: 你们还记不记得冬日祭典上那个叫维茨瓦夫的魔法师，还有他...

say:19:1322067014:1.text: We can build some snowmen for Daimon and bring them to life.
say:19:1322067014:1.source_cn: 我们给戴蒙堆一些小雪人，然后施法让它们活过来，它们就能...

choice_prompt:20:1322067014.text: We can build some snowmen for Daimon and bring them to life.
choice_prompt:20:1322067014.source_cn: 我们给戴蒙堆一些小雪人，然后施法让它们活过来，它们就能陪戴蒙玩耍啦！

say:21:1322067015:3.text: Snowmen? Yes... this is much safer than letting Daimon run around.
say:21:1322067015:3.source_cn: 堆雪人？嗯……这样比让戴蒙跑出门安全多了。

say:22:1322067016:1.text: Okay, let's make a ton of snowmen!
say:22:1322067016:1.source_cn: 那我们就堆好多个雪人吧！

choice:20:1:2.text: Yeah, a snowman can be a playmate.
choice:20:1:2.male: Yeah, a snowman can be a playmate.
choice:20:1:2.female: Yeah, a snowman can be a playmate.

say:0:1322068001:0.text: Pile them up here. When Daimon comes out, he will definitely be surprised!
say:0:1322068001:0.source_cn: 就在这里堆吧，戴蒙一出来就能看到！

say:0:1322069001:0.text: What do we use for a snowman's nose? A femur?
say:0:1322069001:0.source_cn: 雪人……你们都用什么来给雪人做鼻子呢？骨头吗？

say:1:1322071001:1.text: Daimon, we found you some playmates. Time to come out and play.
say:1:1322071001:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，我们给你找了几个玩伴，快出来玩吧，好不好？

say:2:1322071002:1.text: These snowmen are quite charming. It's so fun outside right now.
say:2:1322071002:1.source_cn: 这些小雪人很可爱，外面很热闹……你听到它们的笑声了吧？

say:4:1322071004:1.text: Despite Shemira and Niru's efforts, Daimon won't come out or speak a word. His silence is heavy with meaning.
say:4:1322071004:1.source_cn: 无论雪米拉和尼汝说什么，戴蒙都不肯出来，也不愿说一句话。

say:5:1322071005:1.text: *Sigh*... Please don't be angry at Mother and Father, Daimon.
say:5:1322071005:1.source_cn: 戴蒙……唉……别生爸爸妈妈的气了，好不好？

say:8:1322071006:1.text: Come on, Daimon. Can you please come out? Chippy wants to have a snowball fight with you.
say:8:1322071006:1.source_cn: 对呀，戴蒙，你快出来吧？满满陪你打雪仗！

say:9:1322071007:0.text: I'm about to use my fireworks magic! Come check it out!
say:9:1322071007:0.source_cn: 我可以给你看烟花魔法！

narration:11:1322071008:0.text: Despite everyone's words, Daimon remained silent. His silence is unsettling.
narration:11:1322071008:0.source_cn: 不管大家说了什么，戴蒙依旧一声不吭

say:14:1322071010:0.text: Daimon has been silent too long. Could he not be feeling well...?
say:14:1322071010:0.source_cn: ……戴蒙他一直不说话，会不会是生病了不舒服……？

say:15:1322071011:0.text: I have to go see him.

narration:0:1322073001:0.text: Shemira calls out repeatedly, but Daimon doesn't answer. Worried, she searches their residence, only to discover Daimon is missing.
narration:0:1322073001:0.source_cn: 雪米拉呼唤了许久，依旧没有听到戴蒙的回答。在不安之下，...

say:5:1322073004:1.text: Daimon is gone! How could this have happened?! We were all out here...
say:5:1322073004:1.source_cn: 戴蒙他，他不见了！怎么会不见了……我们这么多人在这里……

say:9:1322073006:1.text: None have passed this way. It may be that Daimon left of his own accord.
say:9:1322073006:1.source_cn: 刚才应该没有其他人来这里，也许戴蒙是自己离开的。

say:10:1322073007:1.source_cn: 自己离开？可是……怎么可能？

say:11:1322073008:1.text: Remain calm. Let us seek clues in the vicinity.
say:11:1322073008:1.source_cn: 先别慌，我们在附近找找有没有什么线索。

say:0:1322074001:0.source_cn: 这里！快看，这里有张小纸条！

say:2:1322075001:1.text: He secretly snuck out again! This is reckless!
say:2:1322075001:1.source_cn: 戴蒙他、他自己偷偷跑出门了……？太危险了！

say:3:1322075002:1.text: What if he gets hurt and sick in the wild?! Without Stitchy to protect him, what if he runs into bad people...?
say:3:1322075002:1.source_cn: 他在野外一定会受伤生病，没有奇奇保护他，万一遇到坏人……

say:4:1322075003:1.text: I have to go find him! Niru, we need to go right now!
say:4:1322075003:1.source_cn: 我要去找他，尼汝，我们……我们赶快去找他！

say:5:1322075004:1.text: Fear not. Let us scour the surroundings with care. The snow lies thick here. Even if Daimon slipped away, his footprints would surely mark his path.
say:5:1322075004:1.source_cn: 先别着急，我们在周围仔细检查一圈。这里是雪地，戴蒙就算...

say:7:1322075005:1.text: Don't panic, my love. We will definitely find him...
say:7:1322075005:1.source_cn: 吾爱，别慌，我们一定能找到他……

say:0:1322076001:0.text: There are footprints the size of a child's here. They may belong to Daimon.
say:0:1322076001:0.source_cn: 这里有小孩子的脚印……可能是戴蒙的。

say:0:1322077001:0.text: The Frozen Paw is just ahead...
say:0:1322077001:0.source_cn: 前面就是白熊温泉旅店了……
say:0:1322077001:0.male: The Frozen Paw is just ahead...
say:0:1322077001:0.female: The Frozen Paw is just ahead...

say:1:1322078001:0.text: *Yawn*... Don't look at me. I'm on night duty. Go find the attendants over there. They're on morning duty...
say:1:1322078001:0.source_cn: 呵欠……别找我，我是值夜班的。你去找那边的侍者吧，他们...

say:2:1322078002:0.text: My son! Have you seen my son?!
say:2:1322078002:0.source_cn: 我的儿子，你见到我的儿子了吗？！

say:3:1322078003:0.text: <shk>AHHH!!!</shk> You're undead! No! The Graveborn are here! Don't come any closer!

choice_prompt:4:1322078003.text: <shk>AHHH!!!</shk> You're undead! No! The Graveborn are here! Don't come any closer!
choice_prompt:4:1322078003.source_cn: <shk>啊！啊啊！</shk>你你你……你是活死人……不，亡……亡灵！！你们……你们别、别过来！

say:5:1322078004:0.text: Well, the temple bigwigs said that the undead here were heroes of Whiteridge... But it's still a bit scary when you come face-to-face with one...
say:5:1322078004:0.source_cn: 呃，圣堂来的大人们倒是说亡灵是白山的英雄来着……可话虽...

say:6:1322078005:0.text: W-what did you just ask before?

say:7:1322078006:0.text: Have you seen a young boy in the vicinity?
say:7:1322078006:0.source_cn: 你有没有在附近见过一个小男孩？

say:8:1322078007:0.text: Daimon is twelve years old, about this tall, and is very thin...
say:8:1322078007:0.source_cn: 戴蒙12岁，大概这么高，而且很瘦小……

say:9:1322078008:0.text: Let me think... There was a young boy near the hot springs last night. He was wrapped up in bandages. I told him if he was injured, he couldn't soak in the water.
say:9:1322078008:0.source_cn: 让我想想……昨天半夜是有一个小男孩在温泉附近。他身上缠...

say:10:1322078009:0.text: The kid was quite polite. He did ask me a weird question though... "Are there any Graveborn nearby?"
say:10:1322078009:0.source_cn: 那孩子倒是挺有礼貌，就是问我的问题挺奇怪……他问我，这...

say:12:1322078011:0.text: Well, you should know best. You're all usually at the ancient battlefield, in the swamps, or deep in the forest. I told him where all the undead near Cedartown come from...
say:12:1322078011:0.source_cn: 呃，你们肯定最清楚，你们都在更远的古战场、沼泽和森林里...

say:13:1322078012:1.text: Did you see where he went after?
say:13:1322078012:1.source_cn: 浑身缠满绷带……对，那就是戴蒙，你知不知道他后来去哪里了？

say:14:1322078013:0.text: I don't know. He disappeared after walking around. I thought he was a guest at the inn and just went back to his room.
say:14:1322078013:0.source_cn: 呃，不知道。巡视了一圈回来他就不见了，我还以为他是旅店...

say:15:1322078014:0.text: Do you mean he's your son? But you're a Graveborn... Wait! That means he's a Graveborn too! Oh no, what did I run into last night!? Ah, I've got goosebumps!
say:15:1322078014:0.source_cn: 他是你儿子？但你是亡灵……诶？他他他……他也是亡灵？！...

choice_prompt:16:1322078014.text: Do you mean he's your son? But you're a Graveborn... Wait! That means he's a Graveborn too! Oh no, what did I run into last night!? Ah, I've got goosebumps!
choice_prompt:16:1322078014.source_cn: 他是你儿子？但你是亡灵……诶？他他他……他也是亡灵？！艾雅啊，我昨天半夜遇见亡灵了！！！好可怕！！

say:19:1322078015:0.text: So Daimon ran away earlier than we thought, and now it's daylight. He could be far away by now.
say:19:1322078015:0.source_cn: 那么说……戴蒙很早就离家出走了，现在天已经大亮。他可能...

say:20:1322078016:0.text: He couldn't have run away! No! Daimon is a good boy...!
say:20:1322078016:0.source_cn: 离家出走？不！戴蒙是个乖顺的孩子……！他只是……只是……

say:21:1322078017:1.text: Don't get too excited, my love. We'll definitely bring him back.
say:21:1322078017:1.source_cn: 吾爱，别激动，在这些新朋友的帮助下，我们会把他平安找回来。

choice_prompt:22:1322078017.text: Don't get too excited, my love. We'll definitely bring him back.
choice_prompt:22:1322078017.source_cn: 吾爱，别激动，在这些新朋友的帮助下，我们会把他平安找回来。

say:23:1322078018:1.text: I recall when you spoke of the Graveborn of Whiteridge to Shemira and the others last night. Daimon seemed most eager to meet Carolina and Ludovic.
say:23:1322078018:1.source_cn: 我记得昨晚你向雪米拉他们介绍白山亡灵的时候，戴蒙很想和...

say:24:1322078019:1.text: Perhaps he went to seek them out.

say:25:1322078020:1.text: That's very possible. Oh, my child...

say:26:1322078021:1.text: Should Daimon seek Ludovic and the others, he will surely <style="highlight">pass through the Petalia Plains</style>... If we hurry, we may yet find him on the path.
say:26:1322078021:1.source_cn: 如果要去找柳博米尔他们，戴蒙一定会路过繁花原野……我们...

say:28:1322078023:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，你可千万别出事啊……

choice:22:2:3.text: He asked where the Graveborn were.
choice:22:2:3.source_cn: 他之前问侍者哪里有亡灵……
choice:22:2:3.male: He asked where the Graveborn were.
choice:22:2:3.female: He asked where the Graveborn were.

choice:16:0:1.text: Took him a while to realize it...
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 这位侍者反射弧还挺长的……
choice:16:0:1.male: Took him a while to realize it...
choice:16:0:1.female: Took him a while to realize it...

choice:4:0:1.text: Calm down! They don't eat people!
choice:4:0:1.male: Calm down! They don't eat people!
choice:4:0:1.female: Calm down! They don't eat people!

choice:4:1:2.text: Aren't folks okay with Graveborn now?
choice:4:1:2.male: Aren't folks okay with Graveborn now?
choice:4:1:2.female: Aren't folks okay with Graveborn now?

say:1:1322078102:0.text: The wreath that boy made is so pretty!
say:1:1322078102:0.source_cn: 小哥哥做的花环太漂亮了！

say:0:1322079001:0.text: Oh, the wreath that girl is holding must've been made by Daimon!
say:0:1322079001:0.source_cn: 咦？那个小女孩手里的花环……那一定是戴蒙做的！

say:1:1322080001:1.text: Hello... where did you get this wreath from?
say:1:1322080001:1.source_cn: 这花环……这花环是你们从哪里拿到的？

say:2:1322080002:0.text: Y-you're Graveborn... Dura above, Elena, come here. Stay behind me.
say:2:1322080002:0.source_cn: 你……你们是亡灵……？艾雅在上……艾琳娜，快过来站在我...

choice_prompt:3:1322080002.text: Y-you're Graveborn... Dura above, Elena, come here. Stay behind me.
choice_prompt:3:1322080002.source_cn: 你……你们是亡灵……？艾雅在上……艾琳娜，快过来站在我身后……别离她太近。

say:4:1322080003:0.text: That's what the acolytes said too. My husband agrees, but I've never dealt with any Graveborn in real life before... My Elena is still young. Please don't scare her.
say:4:1322080003:0.source_cn: 修士宣传过这件事，我丈夫也这么说，可我还从没和亡灵打过...

say:5:1322080004:0.text: No, I won't do anything. I understand... For a mother, her children are everything.
say:5:1322080004:0.source_cn: 不，我不会做任何事，我明白……对母亲来说，孩子就是一切。

say:6:1322080005:0.text: My son Daimon... I don't know where he went. I just want to find him!
say:6:1322080005:0.source_cn: 我的儿子戴蒙……他不知道跑哪儿去了……我只想找到他！

say:7:1322080006:1.text: Your son is missing? No wonder you look so worried. You asked about this wreath, right? Here, you can have it...
say:7:1322080006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，你儿子走丢了？怪不得看着脸色不好。你问这花环，是...

say:8:1322080007:0.text: No, I just want to know who made the wreath.
say:8:1322080007:0.source_cn: 我……我只想知道这花环是谁编织的？

say:9:1322080008:1.text: A boy made it for me. Even my mother can't make a pretty one like this. He was amazing. He finished it in one go!
say:9:1322080008:1.source_cn: ——是一个小哥哥给我做的！妈妈都不会编这么漂亮的花环呢...

say:10:1322080009:0.text: The child was thin with pale skin and wrapped in bandages...
say:10:1322080009:0.source_cn: 那孩子瘦瘦的，肤色看着惨白，还裹着一身绷带……

say:11:1322080010:0.text: I've never seen him before in town. Could that boy have been your son?
say:11:1322080010:0.source_cn: 哎呀！莫非那男孩是你儿子？我就说怎么从没在镇子里见过他呢！

say:12:1322080011:1.text: Yes, it has to be Daimon!
say:12:1322080011:1.source_cn: 裹着绷带，瘦瘦的……没错，那是戴蒙，就是他！

choice_prompt:13:1322080011.text: Yes, it has to be Daimon!
choice_prompt:13:1322080011.source_cn: 裹着绷带，瘦瘦的……没错，那是戴蒙，就是他！

say:14:1322080012:1.text: A long time ago, I relied on sewing and knitting to make ends meet. The lighting in our home was terrible, and my eyesight kept getting worse.
say:14:1322080012:1.source_cn: 那是很久以前的事情了。那时候我靠着做编织补贴家用，家里...

say:15:1322080013:1.text: Daimon wanted to help out and learn sewing and knitting, even as he lay sick in bed...
say:15:1322080013:1.source_cn: 戴蒙心疼我，自己躺在病床上也要跟我学这种编织手法，想多...

say:16:1322080014:0.source_cn: 多体贴、多懂事的孩子呀！

say:17:1322080015:0.text: So Graveborn are much like humans—children worry for their parents, and parents fear for their children's safety. You're not as frightening as I thought.
say:17:1322080015:0.source_cn: 原来你们亡灵和人一样，孩子会心疼母亲，母亲也会担心孩子...

say:18:1322080016:1.text: Did Daimon do anything or say anything besides making the wreath? Did he say where he was going?
say:18:1322080016:1.source_cn: 戴蒙他除了编花环还做了什么、说了什么吗？他有没有说他要...

say:22:1322080018:0.source_cn: 呜呜呜……我想要一个花环，能戴在头上的那种。

say:23:1322080019:0.text: Oh, honey, just you wait. When your father gets back, we'll have him make one for you, alright?
say:23:1322080019:0.source_cn: 乖孩子，妈妈手笨，等你爸爸回来，让他给你编一个好不好？

say:25:1322080021:0.text: You only need to wait one more day. He'll be home tomorrow. Then, we can make one together.
say:25:1322080021:0.source_cn: 唉，这可难住我了。就再等一天，你爸爸明天就回来了，咱们...

say:26:1322080022:1.text: Everyone else has one. I want one, too. *Cry*... Please make one for me.
say:26:1322080022:1.source_cn: 别人都有，我也想要一个……呜呜……妈妈，就给我做一个嘛……

say:29:1322080024:1.text: Really? Are you really giving this to me?

say:30:1322080025:1.text: Yes, this is for you. Don't cry, okay? My mother told me that crying makes children sick, and if they're sick, they can't play with their friends. Bye, I have to go find friends now.
say:30:1322080025:1.source_cn: 嗯，我要去找朋友了。这个送给你，不要哭了。我妈妈说小孩...

say:31:1322080026:1.text: I won't cry anymore. Thank you!
say:31:1322080026:1.source_cn: 我、我不哭了，谢谢小哥哥！

say:33:1322080027:0.text: He made us a wreath and left. He said he was going to find friends. He was heading toward Sorrowfall Lake. Maybe if you go in that direction, you'll find him.
say:33:1322080027:0.source_cn: 他给我们做好花环就往那边路上去了。好像是要去找朋友呢。...

say:35:1322080028:1.text: Thank you so much. Daimon's not as healthy as most children, but he's always running around. I get so worried for him...
say:35:1322080028:1.source_cn: 谢谢你。戴蒙他身体弱，可总是喜欢乱跑，我很担心他……

say:36:1322080029:0.text: Although he's young, your son is smart and capable. He's a very considerate child.
say:36:1322080029:0.source_cn: 你的儿子虽然年纪不大，但又聪明又能干，还很体贴人，是个...

say:37:1322080030:0.text: Don't worry, he'll be fine. Dura will protect him.
say:37:1322080030:0.source_cn: 别担心，他不会出事的，艾雅一定会保佑他。

say:39:1322080032:0.text: Daimon must be exhausted from walking so much. Maybe he's not that far ahead...
say:39:1322080032:0.source_cn: 戴蒙身体弱，走了这么远他一定累坏了，也许他就在前面不远...

choice:13:0:1.text: Is Daimon good at making things?
choice:13:0:1.male: Is Daimon good at making things?
choice:13:0:1.female: Is Daimon good at making things?

choice:13:1:2.text: He sure has a lot of hobbies.
choice:13:1:2.male: He sure has a lot of hobbies.
choice:13:1:2.female: He sure has a lot of hobbies.

choice:3:1:2.text: She's trying to find her son.
choice:3:1:2.male: She's trying to find her son.
choice:3:1:2.female: She's trying to find her son.

say:0:1322081001:0.text: It appears Daimon has gone to Sorrowfall Lake... Make haste. Let us overtake him.
say:0:1322081001:0.source_cn: 看来戴蒙进了哀叹之湖……快点，我们追上去。

say:2:1322083001:1.text: This place is dangerous, and Daimon is alone. There will be trouble if he stays here.
say:2:1322083001:1.source_cn: 这里……这里很危险，戴蒙他一个人……戴蒙留在这里一定会出事！

say:3:1322083002:1.text: The undead do not assail the Graveborn without cause. We were attacked because Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and his two familiars were present.
say:3:1322083002:1.source_cn: 活死人不会主动攻击亡灵，我们遇袭是因为<style=s...
say:3:1322083002:1.male: The undead do not assail the Graveborn without cause. We were attacked because Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and his two familiars were present.
say:3:1322083002:1.female: The undead do not assail the Graveborn without cause. We were attacked because Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and her two familiars were present.

say:6:1322083003:1.text: Don't worry. I've been studying this area for a while. The undead here are not hostile toward the Graveborn. Daimon is not in danger.
say:6:1322083003:1.source_cn: 别担心……我在这附近做了很久研究，它们对亡灵没有敌意，...

say:7:1322083004:1.text: I understand, but the lake here is deep. If Daimon falls in, he may not get out...
say:7:1322083004:1.source_cn: 尼汝，戴蒙他身体不好，这儿的湖水这么深，他……他要是掉...

say:8:1322083005:1.text: My love, you worry too much. Since he has become a Graveborn, he is no longer hurt easily.
say:8:1322083005:1.source_cn: 吾爱，你忧虑过度了。自从咱们转化为亡灵，戴蒙已经没有像...

say:9:1322083006:1.source_cn: 不，我不能冒任何失去他的风险……！

say:10:1322083007:1.text: You don't know the despair I felt at that time...
say:10:1322083007:1.source_cn: 你不知道我当时的绝望……

say:12:1322083009:1.text: Please, let's just find Daimon. Where could he be?
say:12:1322083009:1.source_cn: 请……请找到戴蒙。他可能去哪里？

say:15:1322083010:1.text: If one seeks Carolina or Ludovic, one must pass by St. Kinga's Temple, for it is the gateway to Sorrowfall Lake.
say:15:1322083010:1.source_cn: 如果想要去找卡列琳娜或者柳博米尔，就一定会路过圣金嘉教...

say:16:1322083011:1.text: Let us make for <style="highlight">St. Kinga's Temple</style> and inquire of the acolytes there. Perhaps they have seen Daimon.

say:0:1322084001:0.text: Isn't Daimon supposed to be sick? He ran so far, and we still haven't caught up yet...
say:0:1322084001:0.source_cn: 戴蒙不是身体病弱吗？可他居然跑了这么远，我们还没追上……

say:1:1322084002:0.text: His physical condition is not as weak as before...
say:1:1322084002:0.source_cn: 戴蒙的身体确实不像以前那么虚弱……

say:0:1322084101:0.text: St. Kinga's Temple lies just ahead. Let us go and inquire of the acolytes if they have seen Daimon.
say:0:1322084101:0.source_cn: 前面是圣金嘉教堂，我们去问问那里的人有没有见过戴蒙吧。

say:2:1322085001:1.text: Dura above, please stop right there. Why have the Graveborn come to St. Kinga's Temple?
say:2:1322085001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，请你们停步。亡灵为何要来圣金嘉教堂？

say:3:1322085002:1.text: Oh, it's you, Lady Valka... and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With two other Graveborn I see...
say:3:1322085002:1.male: Oh, it's you, Lady Valka... and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With two other Graveborn I see...
say:3:1322085002:1.female: Oh, it's you, Lady Valka... and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With two other Graveborn I see...

choice_prompt:4:1322085002.text: Oh, it's you, Lady Valka... and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With two other Graveborn I see...
choice_prompt:4:1322085002.source_cn: 咦，是<style=stress><player_name></style>大人和瓦丽卡女士，还有两位陌生的亡灵。
choice_prompt:4:1322085002.male: Oh, it's you, Lady Valka... and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With two other Graveborn I see...
choice_prompt:4:1322085002.female: Oh, it's you, Lady Valka... and Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With two other Graveborn I see...

say:5:1322085003:1.text: Of course, I'll never forget how you saved my life. You look to be in a hurry. Is there something wrong at the lake again?
say:5:1322085003:1.source_cn: 当然了，我永远都不会忘记你们的救命之恩！你们看起来很着...

say:6:1322085004:1.text: No, we have come in search of someone...

say:7:1322085005:1.text: We seek a young boy, a Graveborn. His body is swathed in bandages, and he appears somewhat frail...
say:7:1322085005:1.source_cn: 我们在找一个小男孩，他是个亡灵，身上缠满了绷带，看起来...

say:8:1322085006:1.text: Oh, I think I saw him this morning.

say:12:1322085008:1.text: Please don't get excited, madam. The child was walking around the lake and came to the temple doors to ask if any Graveborn lived nearby.
say:12:1322085008:1.source_cn: 亡灵女士，请不要激动。那个孩子在今天清晨的时候从湖区走...

say:13:1322085009:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know St. Kinga's Temple was built to guard against the undead near the lake. If an undead were nearby, we'd all be deeply concerned.
say:13:1322085009:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know St. Kinga's Temple was built to guard against the undead near the lake. If an undead were nearby, we'd all be deeply concerned.
say:13:1322085009:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know St. Kinga's Temple was built to guard against the undead near the lake. If an undead were nearby, we'd all be deeply concerned.

say:14:1322085010:1.text: So my fellow acolytes and I wanted to keep the Graveborn child here until we were sure he wasn't becoming a dangerous undead and posed no threat to others.
say:14:1322085010:1.source_cn: 所以我和几位兄弟姐妹希望能让那个亡灵孩子留下，待我们确...

say:15:1322085011:1.source_cn: 什么？你们……你们想要囚禁戴蒙？！

say:16:1322085012:1.text: Oh, no, you misunderstand. We just wanted to talk to him and confirm that he was still rational. He was very alert and ran away before we could speak.
say:16:1322085012:1.source_cn: 不，女士，您误会了。我们只是希望和他聊聊，确认他的理智...

say:17:1322085013:1.text: Sister Theresa wanted to stop him, but he exuded a powerful force...
say:17:1322085013:1.source_cn: 特里莎姐妹想要拦住他，但那位孩子激发了很强大的力量……

say:2:1322085201:1.text: You actually wanted to hurt Daimon! He's a young boy! And he's so frail!
say:2:1322085201:1.source_cn: 你们——你们居然想要伤害戴蒙！他年纪那么小！你们——

say:3:1322085202:1.text: No, madam. Your son was very powerful. He was not as weak as you described.
say:3:1322085202:1.source_cn: 不，这位亡灵女士，那个孩子——你的儿子，他很强大，他有...

say:4:1322085203:1.text: What are you talking about?! You must be mistaken. My son has always been weak. He's not powerful at all!
say:4:1322085203:1.source_cn: 你在说些什么？！你错了，不是所有的亡灵都很强大。我的儿...

say:5:1322085204:1.text: Oh, Dura above. Parents understand their children deeply, yet sometimes, they fail to see them clearly.
say:5:1322085204:1.source_cn: 噢，艾雅在上，世间最了解孩子的是父母，最不了解孩子的也...

say:6:1322085205:1.text: Please follow me. I'll show you his power.
say:6:1322085205:1.source_cn: 请随我来，我带你们看看他的力量，或许你们能更了解他。

say:1:1322087001:0.text: Look! This is a mark of his power.

say:3:1322087003:0.text: This was indeed caused by gravecalling magic... Did my son develop a talent for it after his death?
say:3:1322087003:0.source_cn: 这的确是亡灵法术所造成的……我的儿子竟然在死后才涌现了...

say:4:1322087004:0.text: I don't believe it... He's been coughing so much lately. How could he have such strength?
say:4:1322087004:0.source_cn: 我不相信……他一直在虚弱地咳嗽，怎么会有这种力量？

say:5:1322087005:0.text: Niru... We must find him quickly!
say:5:1322087005:0.source_cn: 尼汝……快，我们得赶紧找到他！

say:7:1322087006:1.text: It seems he has indeed gone in search of Ludovic or Carolina, who dwell not far from here.
say:7:1322087006:1.source_cn: 看来他的确是去找柳博米尔或卡列琳娜了，他们离这里都不远。

choice_prompt:8:1322087006.text: It seems he has indeed gone in search of Ludovic or Carolina, who dwell not far from here.
choice_prompt:8:1322087006.source_cn: 看来他的确是去找柳博米尔或卡列琳娜了，他们离这里都不远。

say:9:1322087007:1.text: Lady Shemira seems much distressed. Let us split up and hasten our efforts.
say:9:1322087007:1.source_cn: 雪米拉女士似乎很着急，我们还是分头行动吧，这样比较快。

say:10:1322087009:1.text: I shall take Niru to seek out Carolina. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Lady Shemira can <style="highlight">visit Ludovic</style>.
say:10:1322087009:1.source_cn: 我带尼汝先生去找卡列琳娜。<style=stress>...
say:10:1322087009:1.male: I shall take Niru to seek out Carolina. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Lady Shemira can <style="highlight">visit Ludovic</style>.
say:10:1322087009:1.female: I shall take Niru to seek out Carolina. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Lady Shemira can <style="highlight">visit Ludovic</style>.

say:11:1322087010:1.text: No matter what, I need to find Daimon. I can't lose him again.
say:11:1322087010:1.source_cn: 无论是谁，无论在哪……让我找到戴蒙……我不能再失去他了……

say:13:1322087008:1.text: Yes, this is the swiftest course.

say:0:1322087101:0.text: Don't worry, Shemira. Let's go find Ludovic first.
say:0:1322087101:0.source_cn: 雪米拉，别着急，我们现在就去找柳博米尔。
say:0:1322087101:0.male: Don't worry, Shemira. Let's go find Ludovic first.
say:0:1322087101:0.female: Don't worry, Shemira. Let's go find Ludovic first.

say:0:1322088001:0.text: Lady Shemira, Chippy knows nothing will happen to Daimon! He is very powerful now!
say:0:1322088001:0.source_cn: 雪米拉女士，满满觉得戴蒙不会出事！他很强大！

say:1:1322088002:0.text: Powerful...? That's because you never saw him when he was younger and alive!
say:1:1322088002:0.source_cn: 强大？那是你没有见过他生前的样子！

say:0:1322089001:0.text: I also think Daimon has become very capable now! You're starting to understand, right?
say:0:1322089001:0.source_cn: 我也觉得戴蒙很厉害呢！这一路下来，你应该也有这样的感受了吧？

say:0:1322090001:0.text: There are traces of battle here... It just happened recently...
say:0:1322090001:0.source_cn: 等等，这里有战斗痕迹……很新，才发生不久。
say:0:1322090001:0.male: There are traces of battle here... It just happened recently...
say:0:1322090001:0.female: There are traces of battle here... It just happened recently...

say:0:1322091001:0.text: It's Daimon's! It's one of his bandages! Oh no...!
say:0:1322091001:0.source_cn: 戴蒙……我的戴蒙！这是他身上的绷带！难道他……

say:1:1322091002:0.text: Look! There's a corpse of a monster over there!
say:1:1322091002:0.source_cn: 主人你看，前方有具怪物的尸体！

say:0:1322092001:0.text: This monster died of gravecalling magic...
say:0:1322092001:0.source_cn: 唔……这怪物死于某种亡灵法术……
say:0:1322092001:0.male: This monster died of gravecalling magic...
say:0:1322092001:0.female: This monster died of gravecalling magic...

say:1:1322093001:1.text: These two monsters look the same. Maybe one got killed by someone, and the other one came looking for revenge... like a story from a fairy tale.
say:1:1322093001:1.source_cn: 这两只怪物像是一对，也许是因为那只怪物不知被谁杀死了，...

say:4:1322093002:1.text: I don't care about them! I just want to find my son!
say:4:1322093002:1.source_cn: 我不在乎它们，我只要找到戴蒙！

say:5:1322093003:1.text: Look! Daimon's bandage has blood on it! He must be injured!
say:5:1322093003:1.source_cn: 你们看，这是他的绷带，上面还有血迹！他一定受伤了！

choice_prompt:6:1322093003.text: Look! Daimon's bandage has blood on it! He must be injured!
choice_prompt:6:1322093003.source_cn: 你们看，这是他的绷带，上面还有血迹！他一定受伤了！

say:7:1322093004:1.text: Where is this Ludovic you spoke of? I need to see him immediately!
say:7:1322093004:1.source_cn: 你们说的柳博米尔在哪里？我需要立刻见到他！

say:8:1322093005:1.text: My son shouldn't be in a place like this...
say:8:1322093005:1.source_cn: 我的儿子，他怎么能一个人来到这么遥远的地方……

say:0:1322094001:0.text: Oh, honorable magister, it's you again!
say:0:1322094001:0.source_cn: 噢，尊贵的魔法师大人，原来是您！
say:0:1322094001:0.male: Oh, honorable magister, it's you again!
say:0:1322094001:0.female: Oh, honorable magister, it's you again!

say:1:1322094002:0.text: His Lordship told me to wait for the guests here. I didn't expect it to be you. Come in!
say:1:1322094002:0.source_cn: 子爵先生吩咐我在这里等候客人，没想到居然是您，快请进！

say:2:1322096001:1.source_cn: 戴蒙！我的戴蒙！！你……你没事，太好了……

say:3:1322096002:1.text: Mother! I didn't expect you here!

say:5:1322096004:1.text: I was so worried about you, terrified you might've run into danger out there... When I found your bandage in the forest, my heart sank...
say:5:1322096004:1.source_cn: ……我好担心你的身体，也害怕你在外面碰到什么危险……你...

say:7:1322096006:1.text: How could you leave without a word?! It's too dangerous!
say:7:1322096006:1.source_cn: 你怎么能一声不吭就跑到这么远的地方来？太危险了！

say:8:1322096007:1.text: I told you to stay home, and you snuck out anyway!
say:8:1322096007:1.source_cn: 我说过你不能独自外出，可你竟然偷偷溜出门……

say:9:1322096008:1.text: You haven't properly healed yet! What if your illness gets worse?!
say:9:1322096008:1.source_cn: 你难道没有为自己考虑过吗？你的病还没好，如果再加重了该...

say:11:1322096009:1.text: Please calm down, my lady. You've found your child, and he's unharmed. Doesn't that bring you relief? Will you listen to what he's finally gathered the courage to say?
say:11:1322096009:1.source_cn: 女士，请冷静。你已经找回了你的孩子，他也没有受到任何伤...

say:12:1322096010:1.text: What's wrong, Daimon? What do you want to say?
say:12:1322096010:1.source_cn: ……戴蒙，你到底怎么了，你想说什么？

say:14:1322096012:1.text: It's okay, Daimon. Just tell your mother what you want to say.
say:14:1322096012:1.source_cn: 没关系的，戴蒙。你想说什么，就对你妈妈说吧。

say:15:1322096013:1.text: Mother, I don't want to be protected by you and Father all the time!
say:15:1322096013:1.source_cn: 妈妈，我不想总是被你和爸爸护在身后了！

say:16:1322096014:1.text: Look! I was able to travel this far away by myself. Even without Stitchy by my side, I was able to protect myself.
say:16:1322096014:1.source_cn: 你看，我能一个人出远门，哪怕没有奇奇在身边，我也能保护...

say:17:1322096015:1.text: I don't want to play alone anymore. I want to meet new friends and go where I want to go…
say:17:1322096015:1.source_cn: 我不想再一个人孤零零的玩耍，我想认识新的朋友，去想去的...

say:19:1322096017:1.text: Why do you always think that I am weak, Mother? Why do you never let me do anything? Why can't I have friends?
say:19:1322096017:1.source_cn: 妈妈，为什么你总是觉得我很弱小，需要你的看护？为什么你...

say:20:1322096018:1.text: I don't want to be like this anymore!

narration:21:1322096019:0.text: Daimon chokes out the words in a single breath, his voice breaking. Before anyone can respond, he bolts, tears spilling down his cheeks as he vanishes from sight.
narration:21:1322096019:0.source_cn: 戴蒙一口气说完这些话，流着眼泪伤心地跑开了。

say:2:1322097001:1.text: What happened to Daimon...? He used to be so well-behaved. He would never talk to me like this...
say:2:1322097001:1.source_cn: 戴蒙他怎么了……他以前一直很听话的，他……他从来都不会...

say:3:1322097002:1.text: I'm doing all of this for him... He used to be bullied all the time. Those children never treated him like a real friend.
say:3:1322097002:1.source_cn: 我是为了他……以前他总是被同龄人欺负，那些孩子根本没有...

say:4:1322097003:1.text: Lady Shemira, you speak of events from his mortal life—a life that has long since ended. We are Graveborn now, bound by a different existence, far removed from the fleeting concerns of mortals.
say:4:1322097003:1.source_cn: 雪米拉女士，你说的这些是你们生前之事，已经过去了。现在...

say:5:1322097004:1.text: Daimon isn't as weak as you think—on the contrary, he possesses unparalleled power.
say:5:1322097004:1.source_cn: 不，戴蒙并不像你所想象的那样虚弱，相反，他拥有无与伦比...

say:6:1322097005:1.text: Trust me. I've witnessed it with my own eyes.
say:6:1322097005:1.source_cn: 请相信我。我之前亲眼所见——

say:2:1322097201:1.text: Did you kill that monster and save him?
say:2:1322097201:1.source_cn: 你……是你杀了那个怪物，救了他……？

say:3:1322097202:1.text: Truth be told, his strength alone was more than enough to face the monster. But he's still learning, still unfamiliar with how to wield such power.
say:3:1322097202:1.source_cn: 其实他自己的力量足以与那个怪物对抗，只是他还没有熟悉怎...

say:4:1322097203:1.text: Actually, Lady Shemira, I understand your son very well...
say:4:1322097203:1.source_cn: 雪米拉女士，你知道吗？其实我很理解戴蒙……

say:5:1322097204:1.text: In my youth, my health was fragile. I was confined to home, unable to spend time with friends.
say:5:1322097204:1.source_cn: 我小时候身体也很差，大部分时间都在家里待着，不能和别的...

say:6:1322097205:1.text: My parents strived to give me the best life—gorgeous clothes, exquisite painting supplies, every luxury the world could offer. Yet, despite their efforts, a hollow loneliness lingered within me, untouched by material things.
say:6:1322097205:1.source_cn: 我的父母倾尽全力给我最好的生活——华美的服饰、精致的画...

say:7:1322097206:1.text: What I wanted most was to run and play outside with other children, to laugh and tumble in the mud. But I never understood this longing—not until it was too late, not until I was already gone.
say:7:1322097206:1.source_cn: 我曾经最希望的，就是能和其他同龄人一起在外面奔跑、打闹...

say:8:1322097207:1.text: Now, as a Graveborn, after centuries of existence, after witnessing countless lives flicker and fade, I no longer crave friendship.
say:8:1322097207:1.source_cn: 而现在，成为了亡灵，经历了这么长的岁月，见过了太多的生...

say:9:1322097208:0.text: But when pieces of my childhood resurface in my memory, I still dream... How much brighter those days might've been if I had more friends to keep me company while I lay bedridden.
say:9:1322097208:0.source_cn: 可童年的碎片掠影偶尔浮现时，我还是会想着……如果那时卧...

say:11:1322097210:1.text: Even if it worsened your condition and made your parents cry...?
say:11:1322097210:1.source_cn: 即便那会加重你的病情，让你的父母垂泪……？

say:12:1322097211:1.text: Even parents have no right to make choices for their children.
say:12:1322097211:1.source_cn: 即便是父母，也无权替自己的子女做出选择。

say:13:1322097212:1.text: People always crave what they were denied as children. With each passing day, they strive to fill the void left by those childhood regrets.
say:13:1322097212:1.source_cn: 人总是会奢求童年时无法得到的东西。孩子长大后的每一天，...

say:14:1322097213:1.text: Believe in your son. He has endured life and death. He has grown up.
say:14:1322097213:1.source_cn: 相信你的儿子吧，只要经历过生死，他就已经长大了。

say:15:1322097214:1.text: You just need to understand him, trust him, and respect him. He promised he could protect himself and make friends—and he proved it, did he not?
say:15:1322097214:1.source_cn: 你只要理解他，相信他，尊重他——他说能保护好自己，能交...

say:16:1322097215:1.text: Yes, he did. This whole time, he protected himself...
say:16:1322097215:1.source_cn: ……是的，他做到了。这一路上，他的确做得很好……

say:18:1322097216:0.text: Although he's young, your son is smart and capable. He's a very considerate child.
say:18:1322097216:0.source_cn: 你的儿子虽然年纪不大，但又聪明又能干，还很体贴人，是个...

say:21:1322097217:1.text: Oh, Dura above. Parents understand their children deeply, yet sometimes, they fail to see them clearly.
say:21:1322097217:1.source_cn: 噢，艾雅在上，世间最了解孩子的是父母，最不了解孩子的也...

say:22:1322097218:3.text: Do I not understand my boy as I should? Did I really make a mistake?
say:22:1322097218:3.source_cn: 戴蒙……是我还不够了解他吗？难道我真的做错了？

narration:23:1322097219:0.text: As Shemira loses herself in thought and anguish, Niru and Valka make their way to Everstill Manor.
narration:23:1322097219:0.source_cn: 正在雪米拉陷入痛苦和沉思时，尼汝与瓦丽卡也来到了永寂庄园

say:0:1322098001:0.text: My love, maybe we were wrong...
say:0:1322098001:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，也许真的是我们错了……

say:2:1322099001:1.text: My love, we found Daimon, and he made friends. You should be happy.
say:2:1322099001:1.source_cn: 吾爱，我们找到了戴蒙，他还交到了朋友，你应该开心才对。

say:4:1322099003:1.text: Lord Ludovic is right. We were wrong. We've always treated Daimon as if he's fragile and helpless...
say:4:1322099003:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔先生说得对。是我们错了，我们一直把戴蒙当成病弱...

say:5:1322099004:1.text: Could it be that he's not...?

say:6:1322099005:1.text: He's not. I spent my entire life studying the soul, life, and death. I gave him a second life with my own hands, yet I failed to truly know my son, to understand the resilience and strength hidden deep within his soul.
say:6:1322099005:1.source_cn: 吾爱，他不是。我一生都在研究灵魂、生命和死亡，我亲手给...

say:7:1322099006:1.text: My perception of him remains stuck in the past—back when I barely spent any time with him. How ridiculous it all seems now!
say:7:1322099006:1.source_cn: 我对他的认知还始终停留在过去的时光——在那段日子里，我...

say:8:1322099007:1.text: Becoming a Graveborn is a form of rebirth. You grasp gravecalling magic with ease after your transformation, yet Daimon continues to suffer, his cough echoing weakly... No, this can't be right!
say:8:1322099007:1.source_cn: 成为亡灵就是“新生”。你在成为亡灵之后很快就掌握了亡灵...

say:9:1322099008:1.text: We keep protecting him, holding him back, forgetting that he has been reborn... It's our overbearing care that makes him appear sick, stopping him from realizing his transformation and mastering his new powers.
say:9:1322099008:1.source_cn: 我们将他挡在身后，却忘了他已经获得新生……是我们过度的...

say:10:1322099009:1.text: Take a closer look at our son, my love... Daimon has grown up.
say:10:1322099009:1.source_cn: 仔细看看戴蒙吧，吾爱……看看我们的儿子。他的确长大了。

say:11:1322099010:1.text: Were we actually wrong? Oh, Daimon...
say:11:1322099010:1.source_cn: 我们……我们真的做错了吗？戴蒙……

say:12:1322099011:1.text: Daimon walks up to his mother, gazing into her sorrowful eyes. The frail child who once so small now stands with his back straight and his presence unwavering.
say:12:1322099011:1.source_cn: 戴蒙再次走到她面前，望向她惊讶而悲伤的眼神。小小的孩子...

say:15:1322099012:1.text: Mother, I have grown up. Believe me, okay? I am far more capable than you think. Here, look...
say:15:1322099012:1.source_cn: 妈妈，我已经长大了，请你相信我，好吗？我比你想象的更加...

say:4:1323000003:1.text: Maybe your father's right, and we've been wrong all this time. The love we imposed on you brought you nothing but sadness and pain.
say:4:1323000003:1.source_cn: 也许你爸爸说得对，我们一直都做错了。我们强加给你的关爱...

say:5:1323000004:1.text: I'm sorry... It was never my intention.
say:5:1323000004:1.source_cn: 对不起，这不是妈妈的本意……

say:6:1323000005:1.text: All I ever wanted was for you to be safe and happy...

say:8:1323000007:1.text: I agree to your earlier request. Go make friends with those young people, have fun, and do what you want to do... I trust you to find your own path.
say:8:1323000007:1.source_cn: 我答应你的请求。去和那些年轻人交朋友吧，去开心地玩耍，...

say:9:1323000008:1.text: Your father and I won't stop you anymore.
say:9:1323000008:1.source_cn: 去吧，我和爸爸不会再拦着你了。

say:11:1323000010:1.text: Of course. But you must promise me not to act recklessly or harm others—look, you've mastered powerful spells and are now a powerful Graveborn. With such strength comes the weight of responsibility.
say:11:1323000010:1.source_cn: 当然。但你也得答应我，不要鲁莽冲动，不要伤害他人——瞧...

say:13:1323000012:1.text: And... don't do anything too dangerous—or make sure to tell your father and me before you take any risks, okay?
say:13:1323000012:1.source_cn: 还有……不要做过分冒险的行为——或者，在冒险之前告诉我...

say:0:1323001001:0.text: Daimon, look what I've brought you.
say:0:1323001001:0.source_cn: 戴蒙，看看我给你带来了什么。

say:3:1323002001:1.text: Look, your mother and I put a lot of effort into making this. Do you like it?
say:3:1323002001:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵……看，这是我和你妈妈花了好大力气才做好的，喜欢吗？

say:4:1323002002:1.text: Wow! It's a wooden horse and in my favorite color too!
say:4:1323002002:1.source_cn: 哇！是玩具木马，还是我最喜欢的颜色！

say:7:1323002005:1.text: Oh, it's Stitchy! You won't take him away from me again, right?
say:7:1323002005:1.source_cn: 哇！！奇奇，我的好奇奇！爸爸，妈妈……你们不会再没收奇...

say:8:1323002006:1.text: Yes, never. He's your friend, and we'll never let you be alone again.
say:8:1323002006:1.source_cn: 是的，再也不会了。它是你的朋友，我们再也不会让你孤单地...

say:9:1323002007:1.text: You always mimic the way he talks and pretend he's having a conversation with you, right?
say:9:1323002007:1.source_cn: 我知道你总是模仿它说话的样子，假装它在和你聊天，对吧？

say:10:1323002008:1.text: I will improve upon the big Stitchy's soul again... It will take some time to gather the necessary materials... But once I do, you'll be able to truly chat with him.
say:10:1323002008:1.source_cn: 我会再为奇奇进行一次灵魂升级……需要一些时间，收集一些...

say:11:1323002009:1.text: Really? I can talk and play with him?!
say:11:1323002009:1.source_cn: 以后会有一个可以说话的奇奇？可以陪我玩，还能跟我聊天？...

say:12:1323002010:1.text: Yes, Daimon. Just give me some time...
say:12:1323002010:1.source_cn: 当然是真的，戴蒙，只是还需要一点时间……

say:13:1323002011:1.text: I'll wait as long as it takes!

say:14:1323002012:1.text: Father, Mother... thank you for your trust and everything you've done.
say:14:1323002012:1.source_cn: 爸爸，妈妈……谢谢你们！谢谢你们的保护，也谢谢你们的信任……

say:17:1323002013:1.text: It seems this journey to find your child has concluded successfully.
say:17:1323002013:1.source_cn: 看来这场找寻孩子的旅途圆满结束了。

choice_prompt:18:1323002013.text: It seems this journey to find your child has concluded successfully.
choice_prompt:18:1323002013.source_cn: 看来这场找寻孩子的旅途圆满结束了。

say:19:1323002014:1.text: As a token of my goodwill, I offer you a gift.
say:19:1323002014:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我也送上一份礼物吧。

say:20:1323002015:1.text: Daimon, Lady Shemira, Niru, in the name of Viscount Ludovic Valesa, I extend my welcome for you to settle in the Duchy of Whiteridge.
say:20:1323002015:1.source_cn: 戴蒙、雪米拉女士、尼汝先生，我以柳博米尔·瓦勒沙子爵的...

say:21:1323002016:1.text: You can choose to live wherever you wish, and every Graveborn here welcomes you with open arms. Make yourself at home.
say:21:1323002016:1.source_cn: 你们可以随意选择喜欢的地方居住，这里的每一位亡灵都会衷...

say:24:1323002017:1.text: You shall find the land of Whiteridge to your liking—peaceful and warm, with grand and joyous festivals held each year.
say:24:1323002017:1.source_cn: 你们会喜欢白山这片土地——平和、温馨，每年都有盛大而快...

say:25:1323002018:1.text: Ha! It looks like I'll be able to find a suitable place to build a whole laboratory...
say:25:1323002018:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵呵……看起来我可以找个合适的地方，建上一个完备的...

say:26:1323002019:1.text: My love, set aside your research for now—we need a spacious home first! Daimon has always wanted a comfortable little home where he can place his wooden horse inside.
say:26:1323002019:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，暂时放下你的研究吧，我们得先有个宽敞的房子！戴...

say:27:1323002020:0.text: Ah, you're right. I won't mention the lab for now. I should spend more time with you and Daimon first...
say:27:1323002020:0.source_cn: 哦……是的，是的。吾爱，你说得对，先不谈什么研究室，我...

say:30:1323002021:0.text: Daimon, the Everstill Manor is always open to you as well, so you are welcome to come and play with my attendants whenever you desire. Consider it a place of refuge.
say:30:1323002021:0.source_cn: 戴蒙，永寂庄园也永远对你敞开大门，你愿意的话，可以随时...

say:31:1323002022:0.text: Really? That's great! I'll bring Stitchy here next time! He'll love it!
say:31:1323002022:0.source_cn: 真的？！太好了！下次我要带着奇奇一起来！

narration:33:1323002023:0.text: Daimon jumps up with a smile, and Shemira and Niru share a look, their hearts swelling with warmth. They've never seen him this happy before. Now, they know they'll see Daimon's smile much more often.
narration:33:1323002023:0.source_cn: 戴蒙笑着跳了起来，雪米拉和尼汝微笑着对视——在这之前，...

choice:18:1:2.text: Who doesn't like a perfect ending?
choice:18:1:2.male: Who doesn't like a perfect ending?
choice:18:1:2.female: Who doesn't like a perfect ending?

choice:18:2:3.source_cn: 偶尔当当家庭义工也不错……

say:2:1322045001:1.text: You're pretty strong. Not many can defeat me. You're an interesting one, but you spout nonsense!
say:2:1322045001:1.source_cn: 你很强，你能打赢我！你很有趣，但是说的话太无聊！

say:3:1322045002:1.text: I just want to take my son home.

say:5:1322045003:1.text: No matter who you are or what you want, I won't allow you to hurt Daimon!
say:5:1322045003:1.source_cn: 无论你们是谁，也无论你们想干什么，我都不允许你们伤害戴蒙！

choice_prompt:6:1322045003.text: No matter who you are or what you want, I won't allow you to hurt Daimon!
choice_prompt:6:1322045003.source_cn: 无论你们是谁，也无论你们想干什么，我都不允许你们伤害戴蒙！

say:7:1322045004:1.text: He's not like you... He can't protect himself. Anyone or anything could hurt him.
say:7:1322045004:1.source_cn: 不！他不像你们……没有自保的能力，随便一个人都有可能会...

say:8:1322045005:1.text: Don't try to lure Daimon out with all this "playing" nonsense! He's young, and he doesn't know anything.
say:8:1322045005:1.source_cn: 不要再用玩耍的借口诱骗戴蒙出门！他这么年幼，还不知道如...

say:9:1322045006:1.text: I don't want to hurt anyone, but if you lure him out here again, I'll make sure everyone regrets it—deeply.
say:9:1322045006:1.source_cn: 记住，我不想伤害你们，但如果你们再把戴蒙骗出来……我会...

say:13:1322045008:1.text: Magister... I have to go... Please don't be mad...
say:13:1322045008:1.male: Magister... I have to go... Please don't be mad...
say:13:1322045008:1.female: Magister... I have to go... Please don't be mad...

narration:21:13605401:0.text: After warning everyone to stay back, Shemira takes Daimon home. By the time Captain Rodrigo arrives, they're gone.
narration:21:13605401:0.source_cn: 在警告了众人之后，雪米拉带着戴蒙回家。当侍卫长罗德里戈...

choice:6:0:1.text: No one wants to hurt him.
choice:6:0:1.male: No one wants to hurt him.
choice:6:0:1.female: No one wants to hurt him.

say:1:1322052001:1.text: Lady Valka, have you come to inquire of my research? It happens that I have new findings to share.
say:1:1322052001:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡女士，你是来和我讨论研究进展的吗？正好，我有了一...

say:2:1322052002:1.text: Actually, I wish to acquaint you with some friends.
say:2:1322052002:1.source_cn: 这次我想向你介绍几位朋友。

say:3:1322052003:1.text: Yes, but wait a minute, you must see what I have to show you...
say:3:1322052003:1.source_cn: 不，不，先等等，你一定很高兴看到这个，瞧……

narration:15:13605399:0.text: Thanks to Niru's soul-soothing spell, the once-frenzied undead gradually calm down and are finally laid to rest.
narration:15:13605399:0.source_cn: 随着尼汝“灵魂安抚”的法术，原本发狂的活死人逐渐安静了...

say:1:1322063001:0.text: Are these the materials for crafting the wooden horse? I don't recognize this kind of wood, but it is indeed very strong...
say:1:1322063001:0.source_cn: 这些是做木马的材料吗？这种木料我不认识，但的确很结实……

say:3:1322063003:1.text: It's called a pontail. When the stem of this plant is broken, a liquid will ooze out. It can be used as an adhesive to assemble the parts of the wooden horse.
